channel.title: Newest Python PEPs
channel.description: Newest Python Enhancement Proposals (PEPs): Information on new language features and some meta-information like release procedure and schedules.

item.title: PEP 8105: 2024 Term Steering Council election
item.description: This document describes the schedule and other details of the 2023 election for the Python steering council, as specified in PEP 13. This is the steering council election for the 2024 term (i.e. Python 3.13).
item.author: Ee Durbin (ee@python.org)

item.title: PEP 732: The Python Documentation Editorial Board
item.author: Joanna Jablonski

item.title: PEP 731: C API Working Group Charter
item.description: This PEP proposes to establish the C API Working Group: a small committee of Python core developers responsible for overseeing and coordinating the development and maintenance of the Python C API.
item.author: Guido van Rossum (guido@python.org), Petr Viktorin (encukou@gmail.com), Victor Stinner (vstinner@python.org), Steve Dower (steve.dower@python.org), Irit Katriel (irit@python.org)

item.title: PEP 730: Adding iOS as a supported platform
item.description: This PEP proposes adding iOS as a supported platform in CPython. The initial goal is to achieve Tier 3 support for Python 3.13. This PEP describes the technical aspects of the changes that are required to support iOS. It also describes the project management concerns related to adoption of iOS as a Tier 3 platform.
item.author: Russell Keith-Magee (russell@keith-magee.com)

item.title: PEP 729: Typing governance process
item.description: This PEP proposes a new way to govern the Python type system: a council that is responsible for maintaining and developing the Python type system. The council will maintain a specification and conformance test suite and will initially be appointed by the Python Steering Council.
item.author: Jelle Zijlstra (jelle.zijlstra@gmail.com), Shantanu Jain (hauntsaninja at gmail.com)

item.title: PEP 727: Documentation in Annotated Metadata
item.description: This PEP proposes a standardized way to provide documentation strings for Python symbols defined with Annotated using a new class typing.Doc.
item.author: Sebastián Ramírez (tiangolo@gmail.com)

item.title: PEP 726: Module ``__setattr__`` and ``__delattr__``
item.description: This PEP proposes supporting user-defined __setattr__ and __delattr__ methods on modules to extend customization of module attribute access beyond PEP 562.
item.author: Sergey B Kirpichev (skirpichev@gmail.com)

item.title: PEP 725: Specifying external dependencies in pyproject.toml
item.description: This PEP specifies how to write a project’s external, or non-PyPI, build and runtime dependencies in a pyproject.toml file for packaging-related tools to consume.
item.author: Pradyun Gedam (pradyunsg@gmail.com), Ralf Gommers (ralf.gommers@gmail.com)

item.title: PEP 723: Inline script metadata
item.description: This PEP specifies a metadata format that can be embedded in single-file Python scripts to assist launchers, IDEs and other external tools which may need to interact with such scripts.
item.author: Ofek Lev (ofekmeister@gmail.com)
